name: Diagnostic Row Visibility
description: Which diagnostic-row shapes Nuvio actually renders in the Streams list. Three providers return exactly one row each and differ only in the url scheme / quality / type triple, so the chips that appear identify the field Nuvio filters on. Read-only, no network.

scrapers.name: Diag A · about:error + diagnostic
scrapers.description: url about:error, quality Status, type diagnostic — the shape the novipnoad provider used before this experiment.
scrapers.author: Diagnostic Row Visibility

scrapers.name: Diag B · https + diagnostic
scrapers.description: url https://example.com/..., quality Status, type diagnostic — isolates the url scheme while keeping the novipnoad type and quality.
scrapers.author: Diagnostic Row Visibility

scrapers.name: Diag C · https + hls
scrapers.description: url https://example.com/..., quality Diag, type hls — the shape every working diagnostic provider in this repository uses.
scrapers.author: Diagnostic Row Visibility
